landscape.generation_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: high-detail landscape background panorama for a side-scrolling dark fantasy cave game. One wide 16:9 opaque image, ideally 1536x864 or larger. Highly detailed hand-pixelled fantasy game art: fine deliberate pixel clusters, crisp mineral edges, intricate pitted textures, cracks, damp highlights and layered depth. Rich local detail, no huge flat polygon blocks, no blurry paint, no chunky low-resolution upscaling. Orthographic SIDE VIEW of a horizontal cave passage, as a theatre backdrop; no road receding toward a vanishing point. The foreground walking path and all freestanding props are supplied by the game separately: the image contains only rear rock architecture and distant atmosphere. Composition: intricately textured ceiling and wall fill upper 80 percent, rear floor/water at bottom 20 percent; keep the central lower play area visually quieter with lower contrast so actors remain legible. Muted cold slate blue, charcoal, mineral beige, deep blue-green; tiny warm rust/amber accents. Dark but clearly legible stone detail. No people, monsters, symbols, writing, UI, grid, floating rocks, foreground furniture or freestanding props. Consistent lighting from high left.
Natural limestone chamber: dense fluted mineral ribs and thin layered shelves, chipped calcite seams, jagged roof stalactites visibly attached to ceiling, deep side recesses, wet vertical fissures, small distant pale fungal growth rooted to rear rock ledges. Broad shadowed central alcove and cool reflected light at the foot of the walls.
